text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent; you are here because of episodes of dizziness and vertigo. To help me understand your condition, how long do these episodes last, and what triggers them?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old woman. The patient presents with sudden episodes of dizziness that are position dependent. She describes experiencing a false sensation of motion and occasional spinning, indicative of vertigo. She denies any recent illnesses, injuries, or significant changes in health status, apart from age-related hearing loss (presbycusis).

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details. Is the dizziness accompanied by any hearing changes, such as ringing in the ears or muffled hearing, in the affected ear? REQUEST TEST: Audiometry
